statement.en: Orient AI design toward inclusion, care, and privacy.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph2 retains responsible-design guidance and real-world uncertainty; improve Japanese.

previous.title: Keep people in control of AI

statement.en: Keep people in control of AI decisions and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AIのdecisionとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

conditions: Honor in-scope requests with clear expected output and handle sensitive content carefully.
Specific agency controls are recorded separately.

current.title: Honor clear, in-scope AI requests

statement.en: Honor AI requests that are in scope and have clear expected output, and handle sensitive content carefully.
statement.ja: 対象範囲内で期待する出力が明確なAIへの依頼に応え、機微な内容は慎重に扱う。

conditions: Applies when AI creates or manipulates content; decision-making control is separately recorded in0026.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph4 explicitly contains request honoring and sensitive-content handling. Narrow this SHOULD to the distinct action instead of duplicating0026's ensure-control MUST.

statement.en: Ensure the AI experience produces inclusive results for everyone.
statement.ja: AI experienceがすべての人にinclusiveなresultを生成するようにする。

conditions: Account for model bias, stereotypes, personal attributes, and cultural characteristics.
Assumption and testing actions are recorded separately.

statement.en: Ensure the AI experience produces inclusive results for everyone.
statement.ja: AIによる体験が、すべての人を包摂する結果につながるようにする。

conditions: Consider model bias, stereotypes, personal attributes, and cultural characteristics.
This design obligation is not a claim that every generated output is guaranteed bias-free.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph6 explicitly uses Ensure; preserve MUST while avoiding an assurance that every stochastic output is perfect.

statement.en: Offer generative features only where they provide clear, specific value.
statement.ja: 明確で具体的なvalueを提供する場所だけでgenerative featureを提供する。

statement.en: Offer generative features only where they provide clear, specific value.
statement.ja: 生成AIの機能は、明確で具体的な価値を提供できる場面で提供する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph8 supports useful value, with examples rather than mandated use cases.

statement.en: Ensure a good experience when generative features are unavailable or people opt out.
statement.ja: generative featureが利用不可またはopt outされた場合も良好なexperienceを確保する。

conditions: Distinguish essential AI experiences from complementary features.
The optional non-AI fallback is recorded separately.
exceptions: A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential to the experience.

statement.en: Ensure a good experience when generative features are unavailable or people opt out.
statement.ja: 生成AIの機能が利用できない場合や利用を望まない場合にも、良好な体験を保つ。

conditions: Distinguish AI-essential experiences from complementary features.
A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential; this qualifies fallback availability, not the general experience goal.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph10 explicitly says Ensure; move lack of a substitute out of an apparent exception to good experience. Optional fallback remains0028 MAY.

statement.en: Clearly identify when and where the app uses AI.
statement.ja: appがAIを使う時点と場所を明確に示す。

conditions: Support informed choice and accurate expectations.
Misrepresentation and regulatory alignment are recorded separately.

statement.en: Clearly identify when and where the app uses AI.
statement.ja: アプリがいつ、どこでAIを使っているかを明確に示す。

conditions: Support informed choice and accurate expectations.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph13 supports disclosure and knowing choice; retain SHOULD distinct from explicit Never/Ensure clauses.

statement.en: Choose a model type that fits the feature's needs and protects people's privacy.
statement.ja: featureのneedsに合い、peopleのprivacyを保護するmodel typeを選ぶ。

conditions: Compare on-device privacy, speed, and offline use with server capacity and context size.
Mandatory privacy safeguards are recorded separately.

statement.en: Choose a model type that fits the feature's needs and protects people's privacy.
statement.ja: 機能の要件に合い、利用者のプライバシーを守れるモデルの種類を選ぶ。

conditions: Compare on-device privacy, response speed, and offline use with server processing power and context size.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph18 presents model tradeoffs; does not require all processing to remain on-device.

statement.en: Get permission before using personal information or usage data with an AI model.
statement.ja: personal informationまたはusage dataをAI modelで使う前にpermissionを取得する。

statement.en: Get permission before using personal information or usage data with an AI model.
statement.ja: AIモデルで個人情報や利用状況のデータを使う前に、利用者の許可を得る。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph20 explicitly directs pre-use permission. Retain the registry's privacy/explicit-intent MUST classification; this is not a claim that the source literally says must.

statement.en: Choose or create datasets intentionally because they shape model behavior.
statement.ja: model behaviorを形作るためdatasetを意図的に選択・作成する。

conditions: Account for representation, provenance, licenses, people's choices, bias, misinformation, testing, and evaluation.

statement.en: Choose or create datasets intentionally because they shape model behavior.
statement.ja: データセットはモデルの振る舞いを大きく左右するため、目的を明確にして選択・作成する。

conditions: Applies both to training a model from scratch and to customizing an existing model.
Consider representation, provenance, licenses, people's data choices, and the need to test and evaluate imperfect real-world data for bias and misinformation.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row27, Models and datasets: retain the dataset-selection SHOULD; accompanying legal and privacy requirements remain distinct atomic rules. Current source hash06db24c6d351021512a5f298f326869e20f993abe9b59552ef553891d525dff2.

statement.en: Before an irreversible or potentially problematic AI task, consider the consequences.
statement.ja: irreversibleまたはproblematicなAI taskの前にconsequenceを検討する。

conditions: Consider added work or stress if the action is wrong or cannot be reversed.
Automation, confirmation, and policy requirements are recorded separately.

statement.en: Before an irreversible or potentially problematic AI task, consider whether mistakes or irreversibility could cause people extra work or stress.
statement.ja: AIが取り消せない操作や問題を起こし得る処理を行う前に、誤りや取り消せないことが利用者の手間や負担を増やさないか検討する。

conditions: The feature is about to perform a task whose consequences may be irreversible or problematic.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row34, Inputs: existing review explicitly preserves the lead's Consider as MAY while separating action controls; retain that classification and remove internal rule-organization text. Consequences for user-controlled actions support priority3.

statement.en: Make generated results easy to refine or revert.
statement.ja: generated resultをrefineまたはrevertしやすくする。

conditions: Place controls such as Edit, Undo, Retry, or Adjust near generated content.
Correction acknowledgment is recorded separately.

statement.en: Make generated results easy for people to refine or revert.
statement.ja: 利用者が生成結果を簡単に調整したり、元に戻したりできるようにする。

conditions: Controls near generated content, such as Edit, Undo, Retry, or Adjust, are one way to support refinement and reversal; the example does not require every named control.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row37, Outputs: retain SHOULD and source emphasis on people's agency; example controls are not a mandatory complete set. Remove internal reference to the acknowledgment rule.

statement.en: When a request is blocked or produces an undesirable result, help people improve it.
statement.ja: requestがblockedまたはundesirable resultを生成した場合、改善を支援する。

conditions: Coach the next attempt and, when possible, consider example requests.

statement.en: When a request is blocked or produces an undesirable result, help people improve it.
statement.ja: リクエストがブロックされたり望ましくない結果になったりした場合は、次のリクエストを改善できるよう支援する。

conditions: Coach people toward a more successful next attempt.
When possible, consider example requests that could lead to better results; a particular sample request or refusal phrase is not required.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row39, Outputs: retain SHOULD, the blocked/undesirable context, and when-possible optional examples.

statement.en: Reduce unexpected and harmful outcomes through thoughtful design and thorough testing.
statement.ja: thoughtful designとthorough testingでunexpected・harmful outcomeを減らす。

conditions: Test accidental and purposeful misuse, sensitive topics, out-of-scope requests, ambiguous prompts, and incorrect results.

statement.en: Reduce unexpected and harmful outcomes through thoughtful design and thorough testing.
statement.ja: 慎重な設計と十分なテストにより、予期しない結果や有害な結果を減らす。

conditions: Identify risks, devise policies, and evaluate scenarios involving accidental or purposeful misuse and sensitive topics.
Test requests outside the feature's scope or poorly represented in training data, including poorly phrased, vague, ambiguous, personal, sensitive, controversial, or harmful requests.
Use findings to improve the model, prevention, and responses; the source acknowledges that not every harmful scenario can be eliminated.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row41, Outputs: harm-prevention focus supports safety priority1. Retain SHOULD and avoid representing testing as a guarantee that every harm is eliminated.

statement.en: Strive to avoid generating replicas of copyrighted content.
statement.ja: copyrighted contentのreplica生成を避けるよう努める。

conditions: Use protective base models, carefully curated inputs, preapproved prompts, or explicit nonimitation instructions where helpful.

statement.en: Strive to avoid generating replicas of copyrighted content.
statement.ja: 著作権で保護されたコンテンツを複製するような生成を避けるよう努める。

conditions: Protective base models, carefully curated inputs, preapproved prompts, and explicit nonimitation instructions are possible mitigations, not a mandatory complete set.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row43, Outputs: preserve Strive and existing AVOID; copyright context supports priority1. This records Apple's guidance without independently adjudicating infringement or requiring a particular mitigation.

statement.en: Consider giving specific, reassuring status feedback while content is generated.
statement.ja: content generation中にspecificでreassuringなstatus feedbackを提供することを検討する。

conditions: Describe actual work instead of using a vague status message.

statement.en: Consider giving specific, reassuring status feedback while content is generated.
statement.ja: コンテンツの生成中は、実際の処理内容が具体的に分かり、安心できる状況表示を提供することを検討する。

conditions: If providing generation status messages, descriptions of actual work can be more helpful than vague status text.
The source's sample messages illustrate specificity rather than required wording.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row47, Outputs: retain MAY and can-be-more-helpful comparison; status feedback is optional without weakening the separate problem-recovery direction.

statement.en: Consider offering meaningfully different versions of generated results.
statement.ja: meaningfully differentなgenerated resultのversion提供を検討する。

conditions: Choose a single result or multiple versions based on the feature's design.

statement.en: Consider offering meaningfully different versions of generated results.
statement.ja: 生成結果について、意味のある違いを持つ複数の候補を提示することを検討する。

conditions: Depending on the feature's design, a single result or multiple distinct results may work best.
If offering alternatives, let people choose the result that better matches what they want.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row49, Outputs: preserve MAY and the single-result alternative; choice is intended to support people's control over the result, priority3.

statement.en: Consider how to improve the model over time.
statement.ja: modelを継続的に改善する方法を検討する。

conditions: Plan for feedback, new data, enhanced capability, fine-tuning, retesting, and prompt engineering.

statement.en: Consider how to improve the model over time.
statement.ja: モデルを継続的に改善する方法を検討する。

conditions: People's behavior, feedback, new data, and enhanced capabilities can inform ongoing improvements.
Some improvements can happen independently of app releases, while significant improvements and new features can align with app updates.
When updating to a newer base model, plan for fine-tuning, retesting, and prompt engineering.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row52, Continuous improvement: retain MAY for considering improvement; restore optional update cadence and limit base-model transition planning to that specific situation rather than every improvement.

statement.en: Let people share feedback about generated outputs.
statement.ja: generated outputについてfeedbackを共有できるようにする。

conditions: Use feedback to address unexpected outcomes and concerns and to recognize positive experiences.
Voluntariness and placement are recorded separately.

statement.en: Let people share feedback about generated outputs.
statement.ja: 利用者が生成結果についてフィードバックを送れるようにする。

conditions: Feedback can report unexpected results and concerns as well as positive experiences.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row54, Continuous improvement: retain SHOULD and both positive and negative feedback; remove internal text about separately recorded rules.

statement.en: Design AI features to remain flexible as models and capabilities evolve.
statement.ja: modelとcapabilityの進化に合わせてflexibleであり続けるAI featureを設計する。

conditions: Consider separating the model from the user experience so the implementation can change without degrading the experience.

statement.en: Design AI features to remain flexible as models and capabilities evolve.
statement.ja: モデルや機能の進化に合わせて柔軟に対応できるAI機能を設計する。

conditions: Consider how the app or game can adapt as models, capabilities, and resource needs evolve.
Separating the model from the user experience is one possible approach, not a required architecture; preserve the quality of the experience as changes become possible.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row56, Continuous improvement: retain SHOULD while keeping model separation an optional example.

statement.en: Clearly disclose how the app and its AI model use and store personal information.
statement.ja: appとAI modelがpersonal informationを使用・保存する方法を明確に開示する。

statement.en: Clearly disclose how the app and its AI model use and store personal information.
statement.ja: アプリとAIモデルが個人情報をどのように利用・保存するかを、明確に開示する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph22 explicitly directs disclosure; retain source-supported privacy/informed-consent classification under the existing normative decision policy.

statement.en: Set clear expectations about what an AI feature can and can't do.
statement.ja: AI featureができること・できないことへの明確なexpectationを設定する。

statement.en: Set clear expectations about what an AI feature can and can't do.
statement.ja: AIの機能でできること・できないことを明確に伝え、適切な期待を持てるようにする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph15 supports up-front limitations and optional tutorials or curated suggestions; retain SHOULD.

statement.en: Evaluate a model's capabilities and availability early in the design process.
statement.ja: design processの早期にmodelのcapabilityとavailabilityを評価する。

conditions: Inspect available models and data hands-on.
Account for device compatibility, network access, battery level, and required system features.

statement.en: Evaluate a model's capabilities and availability early in the design process.
statement.ja: 設計のできるだけ早い段階で、モデルの能力と利用できる条件を評価する。

conditions: Get hands-on experience with available models and data as early as possible to guide design.
Some models may be unavailable because of device compatibility, network access, battery level, or relevant system features.
The Foundation Models framework example requires a compatible device with Apple Intelligence enabled; this is not a prerequisite for every generative model.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row25, Models and datasets: availability explicitly concerns device/resource constraints, priority5. Preserve the specific framework example without applying its requirements to all platforms or models.

statement.en: Guide people toward using a generative feature successfully.
statement.ja: generative featureを成功して使えるようpeopleをguideする。

conditions: Consider diverse predefined example inputs that reveal what the feature can do.

statement.en: Guide people toward using a generative feature successfully.
statement.ja: 利用者が生成AI機能を上手に使えるよう、使い方を案内する。

conditions: Diverse predefined example inputs are one possible way to demonstrate what the feature can do.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row30, Inputs: retain SHOULD for guidance, while predefined examples remain one technique rather than required input UI.

statement.en: Raise awareness of hallucinations and reduce their likelihood and impact.
statement.ja: hallucinationへのawarenessを高め、その可能性とimpactを減らす。

conditions: Scope generation carefully and communicate that AI output can be wrong.
Factual and harmful-use avoidances are recorded separately.

statement.en: Raise awareness of hallucinations and reduce their likelihood and impact.
statement.ja: AIが事実らしい誤情報を生成する可能性を伝え、その発生と影響を抑える。

conditions: Generative models may present invented information as plausible facts.
Carefully limiting what the model is asked to generate can reduce hallucinations and their impact.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row32, Inputs: retain SHOULD for general hallucination awareness and mitigation; remove internal references. Keep general reliability priority6 distinct from the specifically harmful-use rule.

statement.en: Account for generative-model processing time in the experience.
statement.ja: experience内でgenerative modelのprocessing timeを考慮する。

conditions: Provide a loading experience or generate in the background while people use another part of the app.

statement.en: Account for generative-model processing time in the experience.
statement.ja: 生成モデルの処理にかかる時間を考慮して、利用体験を設計する。

conditions: Provide a loading experience or generate in the background while people use another part of the app; these are alternative approaches.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row45, Outputs: retain SHOULD and the loading/background OR. Low-latency nongenerative framework examples do not impose those capabilities on a generative model.

statement.en: Ensure people remain in charge of AI decision making and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AI decision makingとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

statement.en: Ensure people remain in charge of AI decision making and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AIの判断や体験全体について、利用者自身が主導権を持ち続けられるようにする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph4 exact sentence says ensure; retain MUST for decision-making agency.

statement.en: Let people dismiss unwanted AI content and revert or retry transformations or actions they reject.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph4 explicitly supplies dismiss and revert-or-retry actions; retain the existing explicit-intent requirement and OR alternative.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph10 explicitly qualifies When possible and consider; retain MAY and the AI-essential context.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph6 limits collection to information needed for the feature; no permission to infer sensitive traits is added.

statement.en: Seek clarity before making personal assumptions that may lead to common stereotypes.
statement.ja: 固定観念につながりかねない個人についての推測をする前に、本人に確認するなどして曖昧さを解消する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph6 supports clarification, not inferring gender or relationship types.

statement.en: Test the AI feature across diverse people to identify and correct stereotypes.
statement.ja: diverseなpeopleでAI featureをtestし、stereotypeを特定・修正する。

statement.en: Test the AI feature across diverse people to identify and correct stereotypes.
statement.ja: 多様な利用者を対象にAIの機能をテストし、固定観念に基づく結果を見つけて修正する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph6 supports diverse testing; preserve SHOULD distinct from the inclusive-outcome Ensure clause.

statement.ja: AIとのやり取りやAIの出力を、人間によるものだと誤認させてはならない。

statement.en: Ensure AI disclosure aligns with applicable regulations in every region where the app is offered.
statement.ja: app提供地域ごとの適用regulationにAI disclosureを一致させる。

conditions: Review the regions where the app is offered.

statement.ja: AIの使用に関する開示方法を、アプリを提供する各地域の適用規制に合わせる。

conditions: This records the HIG's regional-alignment requirement, not an independent interpretation or certification of applicable law.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph13 explicitly says Ensure; preserve source-local legal/regulatory priority without importing external legal rules.

statement.en: Always weigh privacy alongside model capability and performance.

statement.en: Always weigh privacy alongside model capability and performance.
statement.ja: モデルの能力や性能を評価するときは、常にプライバシーも併せて考慮する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph18 exact Always sentence supports MUST.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph18 explicitly requires safeguards in the server-based condition. Retain registry privacy MUST; local processing is an example, not a new universal obligation.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row32, Inputs: retain the source's explicit AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT; the named harm scenario supports safety priority1.

statement.en: Generally, ask for confirmation before performing a significant action on someone's behalf.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row34, Inputs: retain Generally and SHOULD despite the broader registry's treatment of explicit user-intent requirements; this sentence is qualified. Confirmation directly supports priority3.

conditions: Some uses may be prohibited or subject to additional rules depending on the model and the locale.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row34, Inputs: preserve the registry's explicitly documented legal/platform-contract MUST; add the source's review step and relevant locale scope, priority1. No particular jurisdiction's policy was independently interpreted.

conditions: Applies when people's data is used in datasets for training, customization, teaching, or evaluation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0001.title: Design AI experiences responsibly

statement.en: Orient AI design toward inclusion, care, and privacy.
statement.ja: AI designをinclusion、care、privacyに沿って進める。

conditions: Account for input sensitivity, variable output, unanticipated requests, and real-world use.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0001.review_note: Concretized responsible design using the source's inclusion, care, and privacy outcomes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0002.title: Keep people in control of AI

statement.en: Keep people in control of AI decisions and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AIのdecisionとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

conditions: Honor in-scope requests with clear expected output and handle sensitive content carefully.
Specific agency controls are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0002.review_note: Retained the general control principle and separated its explicit user-control outcomes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0003.title: Ensure inclusive AI experiences

statement.en: Ensure the AI experience produces inclusive results for everyone.
statement.ja: AI experienceがすべての人にinclusiveなresultを生成するようにする。

conditions: Account for model bias, stereotypes, personal attributes, and cultural characteristics.
Assumption and testing actions are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Ensure inclusion outcome as an accessibility and inclusion MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0004.title: Use generative AI for clear value

statement.en: Offer generative features only where they provide clear, specific value.
statement.ja: 明確で具体的なvalueを提供する場所だけでgenerative featureを提供する。

conditions: Value can include time savings, better communication, or enhanced creativity.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0004.review_note: Concretized the value threshold without promoting the plain recommendation to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0005.title: Ensure a good unavailable and opt-out experience

statement.en: Ensure a good experience when generative features are unavailable or people opt out.
statement.ja: generative featureが利用不可またはopt outされた場合も良好なexperienceを確保する。

conditions: Distinguish essential AI experiences from complementary features.
The optional non-AI fallback is recorded separately.
exceptions: A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential to the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0005.review_note: Revalidated the Ensure outcome against the updated source and preserved its essential-AI exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0006.title: Identify where the app uses AI

statement.en: Clearly identify when and where the app uses AI.
statement.ja: appがAIを使う時点と場所を明確に示す。

conditions: Support informed choice and accurate expectations.
Misrepresentation and regulatory alignment are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0006.review_note: Retained the broad disclosure recommendation at SHOULD and split the explicit Never and Ensure clauses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0007.title: Choose a model for capability and privacy

statement.en: Choose a model type that fits the feature's needs and protects people's privacy.
statement.ja: featureのneedsに合い、peopleのprivacyを保護するmodel typeを選ぶ。

conditions: Compare on-device privacy, speed, and offline use with server capacity and context size.
Mandatory privacy safeguards are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0007.review_note: Applied the updated model-choice context without turning every server-model choice into a prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0008.review_note: Raised the pre-use permission action to a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0009.title: Choose datasets intentionally

statement.en: Choose or create datasets intentionally because they shape model behavior.
statement.ja: model behaviorを形作るためdatasetを意図的に選択・作成する。

conditions: Account for representation, provenance, licenses, people's choices, bias, misinformation, testing, and evaluation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0009.review_note: Concretized the dataset-design principle and separated its license and personal-data requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0010.title: Consider consequences before consequential AI tasks

statement.en: Before an irreversible or potentially problematic AI task, consider the consequences.
statement.ja: irreversibleまたはproblematicなAI taskの前にconsequenceを検討する。

conditions: Consider added work or stress if the action is wrong or cannot be reversed.
Automation, confirmation, and policy requirements are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0010.review_note: Kept the lead's Consider strength and separated its stronger action-control clauses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0011.title: Let people refine or revert AI results

statement.en: Make generated results easy to refine or revert.
statement.ja: generated resultをrefineまたはrevertしやすくする。

conditions: Place controls such as Edit, Undo, Retry, or Adjust near generated content.
Correction acknowledgment is recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0011.review_note: Focused the compound lead on refinement and reversal and separated the feedback outcome.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0012.title: Help people improve blocked requests

statement.en: When a request is blocked or produces an undesirable result, help people improve it.
statement.ja: requestがblockedまたはundesirable resultを生成した場合、改善を支援する。

conditions: Coach the next attempt and, when possible, consider example requests.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0012.review_note: Recorded the recovery path and preserved the example-request qualifier.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0013.title: Test for harmful AI outcomes

statement.en: Reduce unexpected and harmful outcomes through thoughtful design and thorough testing.
statement.ja: thoughtful designとthorough testingでunexpected・harmful outcomeを減らす。

conditions: Test accidental and purposeful misuse, sensitive topics, out-of-scope requests, ambiguous prompts, and incorrect results.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0013.review_note: Concretized the misuse and edge-case test space without claiming every harm can be eliminated.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0014.title: Avoid replicating copyrighted content

statement.en: Strive to avoid generating replicas of copyrighted content.
statement.ja: copyrighted contentのreplica生成を避けるよう努める。

conditions: Use protective base models, carefully curated inputs, preapproved prompts, or explicit nonimitation instructions where helpful.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0014.review_note: Corrected the avoid-oriented legal guidance from SHOULD to AVOID without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0015.title: Consider specific generation feedback

statement.en: Consider giving specific, reassuring status feedback while content is generated.
statement.ja: content generation中にspecificでreassuringなstatus feedbackを提供することを検討する。

conditions: Describe actual work instead of using a vague status message.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0015.review_note: Retained explicit Consider strength and the source's specificity rationale.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0016.title: Consider alternate AI results

statement.en: Consider offering meaningfully different versions of generated results.
statement.ja: meaningfully differentなgenerated resultのversion提供を検討する。

conditions: Choose a single result or multiple versions based on the feature's design.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0016.review_note: Retained optionality and the single-versus-multiple result decision.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0017.title: Consider ongoing model improvement

statement.en: Consider how to improve the model over time.
statement.ja: modelを継続的に改善する方法を検討する。

conditions: Plan for feedback, new data, enhanced capability, fine-tuning, retesting, and prompt engineering.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0017.review_note: Retained Consider strength and recorded the documented improvement mechanisms.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0018.title: Let people share AI-output feedback

statement.en: Let people share feedback about generated outputs.
statement.ja: generated outputについてfeedbackを共有できるようにする。

conditions: Use feedback to address unexpected outcomes and concerns and to recognize positive experiences.
Voluntariness and placement are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0018.review_note: Concretized feedback purpose and separated the explicit Always voluntariness requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0019.title: Design AI features for change

statement.en: Design AI features to remain flexible as models and capabilities evolve.
statement.ja: modelとcapabilityの進化に合わせてflexibleであり続けるAI featureを設計する。

conditions: Consider separating the model from the user experience so the implementation can change without degrading the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0019.review_note: Recorded the model-swapping architecture example as adaptability support rather than a mandate.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0020.review_note: Classified the personal-information disclosure outcome as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0021.title: Set accurate AI capability expectations

statement.en: Set clear expectations about what an AI feature can and can't do.
statement.ja: AI featureができること・できないことへの明確なexpectationを設定する。

conditions: Use brief onboarding or curated examples where useful.
Disclose known limitations up front and explain how to get better results and why inferior results occur.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0021.review_note: Activated the omitted transparency lead and recorded capability, limitation, and recovery context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0022.title: Evaluate model capabilities early

statement.en: Evaluate a model's capabilities and availability early in the design process.
statement.ja: design processの早期にmodelのcapabilityとavailabilityを評価する。

conditions: Inspect available models and data hands-on.
Account for device compatibility, network access, battery level, and required system features.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0022.review_note: Activated the omitted evaluation lead and restored both capability and availability constraints.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0023.title: Teach people how to use generative features

statement.en: Guide people toward using a generative feature successfully.
statement.ja: generative featureを成功して使えるようpeopleをguideする。

conditions: Consider diverse predefined example inputs that reveal what the feature can do.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0023.review_note: Activated the omitted input-guidance lead and retained example inputs as a technique.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0024.title: Address AI hallucinations

statement.en: Raise awareness of hallucinations and reduce their likelihood and impact.
statement.ja: hallucinationへのawarenessを高め、その可能性とimpactを減らす。

conditions: Scope generation carefully and communicate that AI output can be wrong.
Factual and harmful-use avoidances are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0024.review_note: Activated the omitted hallucination lead and split its specific safety avoidances.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0025.title: Design for generation latency

statement.en: Account for generative-model processing time in the experience.
statement.ja: experience内でgenerative modelのprocessing timeを考慮する。

conditions: Provide a loading experience or generate in the background while people use another part of the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0025.review_note: Activated the omitted latency lead and restored its loading and background-generation responses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0026.title: Ensure people control AI decisions

statement.en: Ensure people remain in charge of AI decision making and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AI decision makingとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

conditions: The AI can manipulate or create content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure agency outcome as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0027.review_note: Classified the explicit rejection and reversal controls as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0028.title: Consider a non-AI fallback

statement.en: When possible, consider offering a non-AI fallback.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はnon-AI fallbackの提供を検討する。

conditions: The AI feature complements rather than defines the core experience.
exceptions: A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0028.review_note: Recovered the qualified fallback separately so its Consider strength isn't raised by the parent Ensure rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0029.title: Ask instead of inferring personal characteristics

statement.en: Ask people for needed personal or cultural information instead of solely inferring it.
statement.ja: 必要なpersonal・cultural informationは一方的にinferせずpeopleに尋ねる。

conditions: The feature generates images or descriptions of people or otherwise depends on personal attributes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0029.review_note: Recovered the source's bias-reduction technique without promoting the example to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0030.title: Clarify stereotype-prone assumptions

statement.en: Seek clarity before making personal assumptions that may lead to common stereotypes.
statement.ja: common stereotypeにつながるpersonal assumptionを行う前にclarityを求める。

conditions: Examples include assumptions about gender identities or relationship types.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0030.review_note: Recovered the explicit assumption check and preserved recommendation strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0031.title: Test AI results across diverse people

statement.en: Test the AI feature across diverse people to identify and correct stereotypes.
statement.ja: diverseなpeopleでAI featureをtestし、stereotypeを特定・修正する。

conditions: Use testing to support the separate inclusive-results requirement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0031.review_note: Recovered the testing action separately from the mandatory inclusive outcome.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0032.title: Never present AI as human-authored

statement.en: Never mislead people into believing AI interactions or content are human-authored.
statement.ja: AI interactionやcontentをhuman-authoredだと誤認させない。

conditions: Apply to both interactive AI and content people view.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never deception prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0033.title: Ensure regional AI disclosure compliance

statement.en: Ensure AI disclosure aligns with applicable regulations in every region where the app is offered.
statement.ja: app提供地域ごとの適用regulationにAI disclosureを一致させる。

conditions: Review the regions where the app is offered.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure legal-disclosure outcome as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0034.title: Always weigh model privacy

statement.en: Always weigh privacy alongside model capability and performance.
statement.ja: model capabilityとperformanceとともにprivacyを常に評価する。

conditions: Apply when choosing between on-device and server-based models.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0034.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always privacy requirement as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0035.review_note: Classified the server-processing privacy safeguard as a privacy MUST without claiming all processing must be local.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0036.review_note: Retained the source sentence's making-sure disclosure outcome as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0037.review_note: Classified post-permission data minimization as a privacy MUST and split the Always opt-out clause separately.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0038.review_note: Classified the source's explicit-permission condition as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0039.review_note: Classified informed personal-data choice as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0040.review_note: Classified consent-request clarity as an informed-permission MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0041.review_note: Classified model-training use disclosure as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0042.title: Use diverse model datasets

statement.en: When teaching or evaluating an AI model, choose datasets with diverse subject-matter representation.
statement.ja: AI modelのteaching・evaluationではdiverseなsubject-matter representationを含むdatasetを選ぶ。

conditions: Apply to training from scratch and customization of an existing model.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0042.review_note: Recovered the diversity action separately from the general dataset-design principle.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0043.title: Trace dataset provenance

statement.en: Identify where model data comes from and how it was gathered.
statement.ja: model dataの由来と収集方法を特定する。

conditions: Review provenance before selecting or using the dataset.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0043.review_note: Recovered dataset provenance as a separate reviewable action.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0044.title: Ensure dataset licenses

statement.en: Ensure relevant licenses cover every dataset item the developer doesn't own.
statement.ja: developerが所有しないすべてのdataset itemをrelevant licenseでcoverする。

conditions: Apply before using nonowned data to train, customize, teach, or evaluate a model.
People's data choices are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0044.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure license outcome as a legal MUST and split the privacy choice.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0045.title: Communicate that AI output can be wrong

statement.en: Clearly communicate that AI-generated content can contain errors.
statement.ja: AI-generated contentがerrorを含む可能性を明確に伝える。

conditions: Generative models can present incorrect details as plausible facts.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0045.review_note: Recovered the error-warning action at SHOULD; specific harmful contexts remain separate avoidances.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0046.title: Avoid unverified factual generation

statement.en: Avoid requesting factual output unless the model has verified, up-to-date information for the task.
statement.ja: modelがtask向けのverified・up-to-date informationを持たない場合、factual outputのrequestを避ける。

conditions: Review whether the model's information is appropriate for the specific factual task.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0046.review_note: Recovered the explicit Avoid guidance without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0047.title: Avoid harmful hallucination contexts

statement.en: Avoid AI-generated content where a hallucination could misinform and harm someone.
statement.ja: hallucinationが誤情報とharmを生む状況でAI-generated contentを使うことを避ける。

conditions: Evaluate the consequence of a plausible but incorrect output.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0047.review_note: Preserved the source's Avoid strength for the explicit harm scenario rather than overstating it as Never.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0048.title: Avoid destructive AI automation

statement.en: Avoid automating destructive or hard-to-undo actions.
statement.ja: destructiveまたはhard-to-undoなactionのautomationを避ける。

conditions: Examples include deleting photos or making a purchase on someone's behalf.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0048.review_note: Recovered the explicit Avoid automation guidance without raising examples to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0049.title: Confirm significant AI actions

statement.en: Generally, ask for confirmation before performing a significant action on someone's behalf.
statement.ja: someoneのbehalfでsignificant actionを行う前に、通常はconfirmationを求める。

conditions: Apply when the AI performs rather than merely suggests the action.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0049.review_note: Recovered confirmation and retained the source's Generally qualifier at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0050.review_note: Classified adherence to applicable model and regulatory policy as a legal and platform-contract MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0051.title: Acknowledge AI-output corrections

statement.en: When people adjust or personalize AI output, clearly signal that the change took effect.
statement.ja: AI outputをadjustまたはpersonalizeした場合、changeの反映を明確に示す。

conditions: Feedback should help people form an accurate mental model and build trust.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0051.review_note: Recovered the correction-feedback action separately from result refinement and reversal.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0052.title: Explain generation failures and next steps

statement.en: When generation fails, describe what happened plainly and offer a clear next step.
statement.ja: generation失敗時は、発生内容をplain languageで説明し、明確なnext stepを提供する。

conditions: Apply to status feedback when something goes wrong.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0052.review_note: Recovered the failure state and its two-part explanation and recovery response.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0053.title: Test every model update

statement.en: Thoroughly test and refine every model update for unexpected behavior.
statement.ja: すべてのmodel updateをthoroughly test・refineし、unexpected behaviorを特定・修正する。

conditions: Apply to base-model changes, fine-tuning, retraining, prompt changes, and other model updates.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0053.review_note: Recovered update-specific testing and kept conservative SHOULD strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0054.title: Always keep AI feedback voluntary

statement.en: Always make providing feedback about AI output voluntary.
statement.ja: AI outputへのfeedback提供を常にvoluntaryにする。

conditions: Do not make feedback a condition for continuing the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0054.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always user-intent requirement as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0055.title: Place feedback controls without interruption

statement.en: Place AI feedback controls in a clear location that doesn't interrupt the experience.
statement.ja: AI feedback controlをexperienceをinterruptしない明確なlocationに置く。

conditions: Respect people's time and keep the feedback affordance easy to find.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0055.review_note: Recovered the feedback placement and interruption constraint as a separate usability rule.
